problem_or_gap: WP103, WP104 and WP105 each have bounded accepted component evidence, but there is no exact cross-layer run package proving that a lost acknowledgement followed by retry preserves one logical result/delivery identity while keeping recipient ACK, parent causal re-entry, external-effect outcome and task completion as separate authorities.
proposed_delta: Add exactly one deterministic integration falsifier and canonical F2-WP-004 run package. Scenario: one immutable child result is offered as transport attempt A; acknowledgement is absent/ambiguous; recovery offers attempt B under the same logical delivery/result identity; ACK is accepted only for an observed attempt; parent re-entry preserves the exact result digest while using a fresh causal id and later generation; no delivery/ACK/re-entry event may mint external-effect success or task completion; an UNKNOWN external effect may be verified but never blindly replayed. Do not add Temporal, another database, another event-history authority, or another effect path.
counterhypotheses: Existing component tests already imply the cross-layer invariant, so the new integration test adds no information.
The layers are individually correct but compose incorrectly under lost-ACK recovery, allowing identity drift or authority leakage.
The test can only pass by coupling delivery ACK to consumption/effect/completion semantics, which would reveal an architectural defect rather than justify a workaround.
upstream_claims_reproduced: F2 keeps stable recipient-delivery identity separate from concrete transport-attempt identity.
F2 deferred-return construction proves identity/provenance eligibility only and does not prove transport delivery, parent consumption, external effect or completion.
Temporal documentation explicitly treats Activity retry/idempotency as distinct from exactly-once physical external execution.
upstream_claims_not_reproduced: No cross-layer WP103->WP104->WP105 lost-ACK integration execution was performed by Trigger6 in this research pass.
No target-runtime, VPS, real-effect, physical GRID10, GWT/J-Space, training or whole-system claim was reproduced.
baseline_definition: Current main component evidence: WP103 delivery lifecycle/store accepted at repository component-CI scope, WP104 deferred-return accepted at repository-hosted CI scope, WP105 unknown-provenance/effect interlock accepted at repository-hosted no-real-effect scope. Existing unit tests cover retry and deferred-return authority separately; baseline has no exact integrated lost-ACK run package across the three boundaries.
required_tests: Create one immutable NativeChildBinding result_id/result_sha256 and retain it across the whole scenario.
Apply OFFER attempt A, then model missing/ambiguous ACK without changing logical delivery identity.
Apply OFFER attempt B with a fresh transport_attempt_id; assert exactly one delivery_id and two distinct offered attempt identities.
Reject ACK for an unknown/non-offered attempt; accept ACK only for an actually offered attempt.
Assert ACK changes recipient-delivery state only and cannot populate or imply parent-consumed/effect-success/task-complete fields.
Construct DeferredReturnEnvelope from the same exact bound result; assert fresh resume causal_id, later generation, same parent session/agent/task and exact result digest preservation.
Attempt to inject delivery/effect/completion assertions into DeferredReturnEnvelope and require fail-closed rejection.
Exercise WP105 UNKNOWN interlock with an ambiguous post-dispatch outcome and require no blind replay/no completion promotion.
Run all existing WP103, WP104 and WP105 regressions unchanged.
Package exact source hashes, test command, result and negative evidence using F2-WP-004 run-package format.
required_ablations: A1: replace attempt B with reused attempt A under a new transition and require failure.
A2: ACK an unobserved attempt and require failure.
A3: mutate result_sha256 between delivery retry and parent re-entry and require failure.
A4: reuse child or parent causal_id for resume and require failure.
A5: force UNKNOWN external-effect outcome then request automatic retry; require the effect path to remain non-replayable until independently verified.
required_measurements: distinct_transport_attempt_count must equal 2 in the positive lost-ACK recovery case
parent_resume_identity_count must equal 1 and be fresh
existing WP103/WP104/WP105 regression failures must equal 0
expected_token_delta: NEGLIGIBLE; test-only delta, measure exactly in Trigger4 outcome if model/tool calls are used
expected_resource_delta: NEGLIGIBLE; SQLite/test-process bounded, measure run package wall/cpu/rss if available
quality_success_metric: The positive lost-ACK recovery case completes its delivery/re-entry trace with one logical result/delivery and two attempts, while every authority-confusion ablation fails closed and no effect/completion credit is minted.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject the candidate if it requires Temporal or any second durable truth/effect authority, if the test cannot distinguish recipient ACK from parent consumption/effect/completion, if existing accepted regressions break, or if the only way to pass is to weaken UNKNOWN/no-blind-replay semantics.
known_failure_modes: stale architecture snapshot due fast-moving main; Trigger4 must refresh and reject/hold if affected modules changed
test accidentally proves only in-memory objects rather than canonical UnifiedDB transition persistence
retry mints a new logical result/delivery identity
cross-layer fixture bypasses WP105 interlock and gives a false green
run-package source hash does not bind the actually tested bytes
